title: DevOps Engineer
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
You are a proactive DevOps Engineer with a passion for IT and a collaborative, customer-focused mindset. As a key member of a cross-functional squad, you design, develop, test, and deliver applications, while also supporting maintenance and decommissioning when needed. You work end-to-end in Agile, continuously improving both your skills and your team's. With a full stack understanding, you manage everything from design to deployment and incident resolution, always aligning with business goals to deliver the best solutions.
You will be part of the Global Account Management System area within Wholesale Banking Tech, Network and Core Banking. You will collaborate with multiple teams spread across domains in Philippines, India, Belgium, The Netherlands, and more. We follow a Scrum Agile development process and strongly believe in the DevOps approach to deliver better software faster. We work with the latest technologies, tools, and frameworks, which means that you work in a dynamic environment in which you are continuously learning. If you have bright ideas, they will be valued and supported by both your peers and your management.
Automate testing, deployment, and rollback processes
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with integrated security checks
Work within Linux environments (preferably RHEL 8+) for deployment and troubleshooting.
Utilize Git for version control and collaborative development.
Conduct static and dynamic code analysis and manage vulnerability scans
Embed security tools and practices into development workflows
Contribute to containerization efforts using Docker.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
Manage Observability KPI’s and SLI’s
Manage IT risk, vulnerabilities and technical compliance
Participate in incident response and post-mortem analysis
Ensure systems meet regulatory and organizational compliance
Key Capabilities/Experience
Knowledgeable in Full SDLC
DevOps operation on Java Application
Azure DevOps and similar platforms
Solid understanding of Linux (RHEL 8 or higher).
Automate provisioning and configuration on cloud and on prem infrastructure
SQL and PL/SQL, particularly with Oracle databases.
Any Scripting Language (BASH, Python, GOLANG)
Any Messaging Platform (MQ, Kafka)
Any Observability tools (Prometheus, Open Telemetry etc.)
Understand and apply security integration (Sonarqube, OWASP)
Familiarity with Docker for containerization.
Willingness to learn new tools and platforms, including Finacle and INGenious.
Openness to continuous learning and adapting to evolving technologies.
Essential attributes:
Strong analytical skill
Open to technology changes
Strong sense of ownership
Effective collaboration
Ability to work in agile environment
Understanding of JSON data structures.
Knowledge of SOAP and RESTful APIs.
Knowledge of ITGC Controls and its fundamentals
Exposure to Finacle Scripting (IS and CT scripts).
Fundamentals of any Programming Language
Minimum Qualifications
At least 5 years of relevant working experience bridging the gap between business and IT.
Proficient and experienced using various techniques for requirements elicitation, functional design and slicing Epics and features into user stories.
A bachelor’s or post-graduate degree.
Experience in working in a complex and challenging environment.
Experience with an agile way of working.
Knowledgeable about core banking services and related financial services.
